boundaryName: HelloblueGK DO-178C Level A certification boundary
description: The declared set of source files held to DO-178C Level A objectives. This is a
deliberately narrow boundary that the project actually meets, not an aspiration:
CI hard-fails when any unit inside it stops meeting the objectives. Files outside
the boundary are ordinary code and are not claimed as certified.
Add a unit only once it genuinely meets the objectives, with its MC/DC analysis
recorded below. Removing a unit is a de-certification and needs the same scrutiny

rationale: Computes the pressure, velocity, turbulence, and heat-transfer fields that feed
engine design decisions. A wrong result here propagates into the geometry and

testEvidence.description: AdvancedCFDSolver_RunSimulationSelfInitializesWhenInitializeWasSkipped drives every decision in the file, including the self-initializing guard.

method: Every decision in this file is single-condition: the source contains no && or
|| operators. DO-178C treats MC/DC as equivalent to decision coverage for a
single-condition decision, because the lone condition trivially and
independently determines the outcome. Each decision therefore contributes one
independence pair, demonstrated by exercising both of its outcomes.
Outcomes that cannot be reached are excluded from the denominator with a
justification rather than counted as demonstrated.

pairs.note: False outcome via callers that call Initialize() first; true outcome via the direct RunSimulation call that skips initialization.

pairs.decision: for (int j = 0; j < 1000; j++) in CalculatePressureDistribution
for (int j = 0; j < 1000; j++) in CalculateVelocityField
for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) in CalculateTurbulenceIntensity
for (int j = 0; j < 1000; j++) in CalculateTurbulenceIntensity

pairs.note: False for iterations 0..138, true at iteration 139 where the loop breaks.

pairs.decision: for (int iteration = 0; iteration < 1000; iteration++) in RunConvergenceAnalysis
justification: The loop always exits through the residual break. With initialResidual = 1.0
and residual = exp(-0.1 * iteration), the residual falls below 1e-6 at
iteration 139, so the loop-exit outcome iteration == 1000 is unreachable for
every possible input. The bound is a defensive cap, not a reachable path.
Excluded from the MC/DC denominator under the DO-178C treatment of
unreachable outcomes rather than claimed as demonstrated.

toolFidelityNotes: Coverlet reports 14 of 14 branch outcomes covered for this file, which includes
the outcome recorded above as infeasible. Coverlet instruments loop branches
rather than performing reachability analysis, so its count is optimistic by one
outcome. The MC/DC figure the gate enforces comes from the pair analysis above,
not from the tool's branch count, which is why the two numbers differ.
Statement and branch percentages are taken from the tool; MC/DC is not.
